detail.title: Compositional Heredity and Error Thresholds in Prebiotic Systems
detail.summary: Heritability and evolution can potentially precede the emergence of genetically encoded templates in non-equilibrium systems, driven by autocatalytic motifs. Informational stability is contingent upon copying fidelity maintaining composition across growth-division regimes.
detail.reason: Refining the connection between autocatalytic motifs and hereditable information transfer.
